div.div: The Default (Immediate): Without this setting, the CSI Controller creates the volume the moment you create the PVC. It might pick us-east-1a by accident, even if your pod eventually needs to run in us-east-1b.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(#ffffff, var(--ge-dark-color, #121212)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 396px; height: 1px; padding-top: 170px; margin-left: 464px;

display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: The Smart Way (WaitForFirstConsumer): The CSI Driver delays everything. It waits until the Kubernetes Scheduler says: "I have found a perfect home for this pod on Node-X in us-east-1b." Only then does the CSI Driver trigger the volume creation in that exact zone.

div.div: PersistentVolume (PV): The actual "Physical Apartment." It is a cluster-wide resource that represents the real EBS disk. It contains details like capacity, volume ID, and the filesystem type.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(#ffffff, var(--ge-dark-color, #121212)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 413px; height: 1px; padding-top: 400px; margin-left: 366px;

display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: PersistentVolumeClaim (PVC): The "Rental Application." A developer creates this to say, "I need 50GB of fast storage." It doesn't care if it's EBS, EFS, or a local disk.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(#ffffff, var(--ge-dark-color, #121212)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 413px; height: 1px; padding-top: 500px; margin-left: 366px;

div.div: StorageClass (SC): The "Brochure." It defines the tiers available (e.g., "Gold" for io2, "Silver" for gp3). It tells Kubernetes which CSI driver to use and what parameters (like iops) to apply.
